show: The Sex Lives of College Girls
seoTitle: The Sex Lives of College Girls Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Sex Lives of College Girls test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Kimberly, Bela, Leighton, Whitney or Kacey — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the hard worker, the comedian, or the ice queen with a secret? Answer 12 everyday questions about college, friendship and finding yourself, and find out which character from The Sex Lives of College Girls you are.

characters.name: Kimberly Finkle
characters.title: The Hard Worker
characters.summary: Book-smart, earnest and determined. You worked hard to get here, and you're not wasting a minute of it.
description: Like Kimberly, you've earned your place. She's a working-class student from Gilbert, Arizona, who's at Essex on a scholarship.
You've got big dreams. Kimberly wants to become a Supreme Court Justice one day.
You're still figuring out the rest. Kimberly is the most innocent of the four roommates, and college teaches her a lot, fast.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything, especially the fun stuff.
characters.signature: A library card, a part-time job and a five-year plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn a fun night into a study session

characters.name: Bela Malhotra
characters.title: The Comedian
characters.summary: Bold, confident and a little bit crass. You want to be famous, and you're not shy about saying so.
description: Like Bela, you've got big ambitions. She's from Nutley, New Jersey, and she's desperate to become a comedy writer.
You say what everyone else is thinking. Bela is confident, sex-positive and unapologetically crass.
You make your own opportunities. Bela starts an all-female comedy group, and later runs an all-women comedy magazine.
characters.flaw: You'd do almost anything for recognition, even when it backfires.
characters.signature: A notebook of jokes, a lot of confidence and a plan to be famous.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your private life into their next bit

characters.name: Leighton Murray
characters.title: The Ice Queen
characters.summary: Polished, private and sharper than you let on. You keep your guard up, and your real self to yourself.
description: Like Leighton, you come from money. She's a wealthy legacy student from New York City with an old-money background.
You keep your secrets close. Leighton spent her first year hiding that she's a lesbian, even from her roommates, before coming out.
You're smarter than you seem. Leighton eventually leaves Essex for a maths programme at MIT.
characters.flaw: You'd rather seem cold than let anyone see you care.
characters.signature: Designer everything, a cutting comment and a secret you're not ready to share.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you feel underdressed with one look

characters.name: Whitney Chase
characters.title: The Athlete
characters.summary: Driven, grounded and steady under pressure. You've always known what you want, until college made you wonder.
description: Like Whitney, you're a natural competitor. She's a soccer star from Seattle and the daughter of a US senator.
You keep a cool head. Whitney is focused and level-headed, even when her life gets messy.
You're more than one thing. As college goes on, Whitney starts to explore who she is beyond soccer.
characters.flaw: You put your goals ahead of everything, sometimes even your friends.
characters.signature: Soccer cleats, a packed schedule and a senator for a parent.
characters.clashReason: they'd always pick practice over your plans

characters.name: Kacey
characters.title: The Pageant Girl
characters.summary: Polished, put-together and always performing. You care a lot about how things look, and it takes a while to let people in.
description: Like Kacey, you're a perfectionist about appearances. She's a former pageant girl who transfers to Essex from Duke.
You keep people at arm's length at first. Kacey arrives focused on her long-term boyfriend, and isn't in a hurry to make new friends.
You're a performer at heart. Kacey joins the theatre department, and there's more to her than the perfect smile.
characters.flaw: You can be passive-aggressive instead of just saying what's wrong.
characters.signature: A perfect smile, a pageant sash and a boyfriend you mention a lot.
characters.clashReason: they'd leave you a polite note instead of just talking to you

questions.text: It's your first week at college. You...

options.text: Find the library and read every course outline twice
Sign up for every club that might get you noticed
Stick with people from your old circle
Head straight to practice. Everything else can wait

questions.text: Your roommate keeps leaving dirty dishes in the sink. You...

options.text: Leave a very polite note. With a smiley face. A sharp one
Say something cutting and go back to your phone
Wash them yourself, then worry for days about bringing it up
Make a joke about it in front of everyone
Pick up an extra shift and live on instant noodles
Wait. What does 'tight' mean?
Stick to your budget. You've got it handled
Pitch a money-making scheme that's definitely going to work

questions.text: You've got a crush on someone. You...

options.text: Make the first move, loudly
Overthink every text for a week
Keep it completely to yourself
Remind yourself you've got a boyfriend back home. Mostly

questions.text: Someone embarrasses you at a party. You...

options.text: Turn it into a bit, and own the room
Leave. You will not be seen like this
Shrug it off. You've got bigger things to worry about
Smile through it, fix your make-up, then make a comeback

questions.text: You've got a big exam tomorrow. You...

options.text: Study all night. Your scholarship depends on it
Skim it once. You'll still ace it
Revise properly, then get a solid eight hours
Cram, then spend the exam thinking about your comedy set

questions.text: Your mum or dad comes to visit you at college. You...

options.text: Spend hours making sure you look perfect for them
Brace yourself. Their expectations are impossible
Keep it low-key, so nobody makes a fuss about who they are
Show them everything, so proud you could cry

questions.text: You're offered a spot in a big campus show. You...

options.text: Yes! You've been waiting your whole life for this
Only if you get a solo
Agree, then panic about it for a week
Absolutely not

questions.text: Your friends need you on the same night as your big event. You...

options.text: Choose the event. You can't let your team down
Try to do both, and end up exhausted
Choose whichever gets you more attention
Go wherever you'll look best in the photos

questions.text: Someone finds out a secret about you. You...

options.text: Deny everything, calmly and convincingly
Deal with it head-on. Hiding it never works
Laugh about it, loudly, before anyone else can
Act like you don't care, then cry in the bathroom

questions.text: You've just moved into a college dorm with three total strangers. You...

options.text: Make a chore chart and a group chat before they've even unpacked
Plan a party for tonight
Ask if there's any way at all to get a single room
Be friendly, but keep your focus on your own goals

questions.text: You transfer to a new college halfway through the year, and your new roommates are already best friends. You...

options.text: Keep your distance, and focus on your boyfriend
Try way too hard to make them like you
Find your own people through a team or a club
Act like you don't need them, while secretly hoping they'll invite you out
